C1358.title: Badger DAO Permission Vulnerability Attack Incident
C1358.summary: In December 2021, the DeFi protocol Badger DAO suffered an attack resulting in a loss of approximately $120 million. The attacker injected malicious wallet requests into the user interface, tricking users into approving token spending permissions for a malicious address, thereby gaining control of user vault funds and transferring them.
